occurrences.text: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.
Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;
Use hospitality one to another without grudging.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
